entities.summary: Giorgi (Gia) Benashvili is a Georgian entrepreneur, national security officer and politician who has served as a member of the Parliament of Georgia since 2016. Educated in the former Soviet Union, he worked in the national security sector from 1988, first in the Soviet government of Georgia and then under the independent Republic of Georgia. After leaving the public sector to work as a security consultant for several large companies from 2007, he entered politics in 2016 when he was elected to the Georgian Parliament on the electoral list of the ruling Georgian Dream party.
